title: fisk-ai A2A v1 select answer
description: Answers a select question with a position in the options the question sent. Nothing authenticates it beyond the transport's own permissions: whoever may address a running task may answer its questions.

index.description: A position in the options that were sent. An index outside them is treated as no choice. 0 is the first option and is sent as one, which is why the field is required rather than omitted when empty.
